scope: Working-copy campaign operator commands with a durable command record, decision-scope refusal, the campaign control profile and its Nickel contract, the definitions, inbox and command routes, console controls and the synthetic exploration workspace. Unit tests over real SQLite campaign stores and control profiles, Node UI tests and a browser review of the local exploration workspace; no live campaign, real worker, model, credential, provider or remote effect, and no deployment.
immediate_outcome: An authorized operator previews and starts configured campaigns, pauses, continues and cancels admission, and issues and answers decisions from the console through the canonical owner, with idempotent retries and refreshable conflicts.
durable_capability: CampaignStore::apply_operator with a request-ID command record shared by console and future authority bindings; CampaignState::decision_in_current_scope shared by decision admission and resolution; kiln_web_service::campaign_controls.
